title: pipe_popover_anchor duplicates the pipe-midpoint math the render package already computes inline (draw_demolish_popover)
evidence:
exec.odin:468-475: "pipe_popover_anchor :: proc(inp: ^Input, ps: u32) -> rl.Vector2 {
	t := inp.topo
	sa, _ := pp.node_slot(t, t.pipe_a[ps])
	sb, _ := pp.node_slot(t, t.pipe_b[ps])
	a := rnd.node_screen(inp.view, t.node_pos[sa])
	b := rnd.node_screen(inp.view, t.node_pos[sb])
	return {(a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2}
}" ; popover.odin:88-92: "sa, _ := pp.node_slot(topo, topo.pipe_a[ps])
		sb, _ := pp.node_slot(topo, topo.pipe_b[ps])
		a := node_screen(v, topo.node_pos[sa])
		b := node_screen(v, topo.node_pos[sb])
		anchor := rl.Vector2{(a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2}" ; popover.odin:9-11: "Layout is owned HERE (the prototype's "layout is owned HERE so the app and any capture agree on the rects" rule): the app hit-tests the SAME rects this package draws (popover_rect / demolish_button_rect)."
detail: The delta's 'ONE copy' claim covers only the hit-test copies; the pipe anchor math now lives in input.pipe_popover_anchor AND inline in render.draw_demolish_popover, while render's header declares it owns the layout — a future anchor change in render silently drifts the input hit-test (the same pre-existing duplication the delta relocated from main.odin, not a regression).
recommended_fix: Move the midpoint math into render (e.g. pipe_popover_anchor(v, topo, ps) in popover.odin next to the rects it already owns) and call it from both draw_demolish_popover and input.pipe_popover_anchor.
